title: 有馬記念の後に・燃料、補給

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun runs with all she's got, but she ultimately loses to Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she enjoyed the race so much she can't contain her excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also realizes that Narita Brian is not yet satisfied, so…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to give her yet another exciting bout at the Hanshin Daishoten.
